displayName: MedXpert-CONT-001 · 官网与内容运营规范
description: An internal standard for running a company website and its content operations, covering how pages, copy and publishing workflows are documented and kept consistent. It is a reference document rather than an interactive tool. Use when you need the agreed conventions for site content or want to align existing pages and publishing steps with them. MedXpert 官网与内容运营规范（定稿）：视觉规范 v2、AI 友好隐藏原则、内容原则、乐享→官网同步流程、整站改版纪律与页面检查清单，覆盖官网/公众号/物料全部对外内容的一致性、合规与同步。
